wiki.summary: A four-minute R&B track, “Don’t Worry” is Drake expressing his vulnerability, amidst the feelings of confusion he experiences. Furthermore, the track paints a picture of longingness; the melancholy Drake exudes in his laid-back songs. Read more on Last.fm.
